LocalGraph.comment: Per-graph metadata Meaningful Object. SINGLE owned subject graph_subject(graph_id) in the :projection:graph named graph. Code-defined span (rdf_record_materializer::graph_desired_triples) — this contract is the AUTHORED minimal mirror of that span, used to DERIVE the SHACL conformance shapes (EA-2b). created/modified are SIMPLE string literals (the materializer emits sparql_string_literal, NOT ^^xsd:dateTime), so they are declared datatype=string here to match the real projection byte-for-byte.

comment: EA-2b SHACL retrofit contract for the Graph-metadata Meaningful Object. NOT a served emporium pack — an AUTHORED minimal mirror of the code-defined graph_desired_triples span (8 triples on one subject), whose sole consumer is vocab_to_shacl (the conformance-oracle shapes source). mnemo: is the runtime MNEMO_NS (https://mnemosyne.local/ns#), matching rdf_record_materializer.
description: Per-graph metadata: a single LocalGraph subject carrying its dcterms identity/title/timestamps and mnemo filesystem provenance.
